newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai budget deficit up to 58 bln baht in 5 mths.
newsitem.headline: Thai budget deficit up to 58 bln baht in 5 mths.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Thursday the government posted a 58.1 billion baht budget deficit during the first five months of the current fiscal year ending September 30, 1997.
Amnuay told reporters total government expenditure amounted to 364.15 billion baht ($14 billion) between October and February against tax revenue of 306.03 billion.
The minister has since last month initiated hefty cuts in national and state enterprise budgets to help the government meet its balanced, deficit-free budget target in the 1996/1997 fiscal year.
Thailand has enjoyed a budget surplus in each of the past nine years but its current economic slowdown has sharply trimmed tax revenues so far this year. (US$1 = 26 baht)
